about_heading: Two dentists, one practice, opened this year
about_body:
Rise Modern Dentistry opened in Davidson in January 2026. It is co-owned by Dr. Brandon Morales and Dr. Cody Miller, who run it together rather than passing patients between associates.

The practice covers general and restorative care, cosmetic work and orthodontics, so most of what a family needs is handled in one place, by dentists they already know.
